scope: Original Battle of Legends Volume One: Alice, King Arthur, Medusa and Sinbad, standard duel; applicable current official2025 erratum and explicitly historical interpretation. Optional teams/other sets/Adventures excluded.

method.data_boundary: Only this exact stamped summary and listed original/authoritative sources; no questions, keys, prior reviews, reader outputs or grades. All derived artifacts confined to this directory.
method.card_examination: Direct native visual examination of all printed cells, including duplicate copies; no OCR. Manual normalized source transcription is retained, with label/type/value/BOOST/copies/effect/timing/conditions.
method.html: Independent original-markup parse retained; complete visible page and body delivered and compared against both complete supplied v2 captures.
method.pdf: Original PDF gameplay diagrams rendered with requested project .venv fitz and inspected natively; derivatives only in audit07.

checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: May hold over seven during turn; discard excess only at turn end before opponent’s turn.

checked_claims.claim: Maneuver mandatory draw first
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Top card to hand before optional movement.

checked_claims.claim: Independent optional fighter movement and order
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Each fighter one at a time, finish before another; any distance up to value, including zero.

checked_claims.claim: Path/blocker rules; moving opponents uses owner perspective; card movement application
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Each entered space adjacent; friendly transit allowed, occupied endpoints prohibited; opposing transit prohibited; owner perspective explicit for opponent movement. Card exception overrides restriction.

checked_claims.claim: One-card maneuver boost, BOOST not combat number, effects ignored and defeated-fighter cards usable
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Discard 1 hand card; add printed BOOST to movement value; ignore effect. Otherwise unplayable defeated-fighter cards may still boost. Other boost needs effect permission.

checked_claims.claim: Scheme active fighter eligibility, face-up resolution and discard
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Declare active fighter permitted by label; cannot use if listed fighters defeated; face-up resolve then discard. ANY is permission, not a destination restriction.

candidate_location.text: You cannot take an attack action

checked_claims.claim: Attack requires attack card and valid target
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Prohibits action without an attack card or any valid fighter target.

checked_claims.claim: Active attacker and target; melee adjacency; ranged same-zone including adjacency across zone boundaries
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Any fighter may target adjacent regardless of zone; ranged may target anywhere in same zone regardless of adjacency.

checked_claims.claim: Legal fighter-specific face-down cards, optional defense, simultaneous reveal
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Attacker must choose permitted attack; defender may choose permitted defense; reveal at same time after choices.

checked_claims.claim: Card roles, ANY eligibility, versatile counts as both for other effects
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Attack red star; defense blue shield; versatile purple combined icon; scheme yellow lightning. Fighter label C in anatomy restricts use; versatile explicitly both roles and both types for game effects.

checked_claims.claim: Combat timing ordering through final discard
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Immediately → during combat → determine damage → after-combat cards (including defeated sidekick) → other after-combat effects → played cards to discards.

checked_claims.claim: Attack minus defense minimum zero, undefended full attack, defender only takes attack damage
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Damage dealt by attacker; subtract defense value; higher defense cannot generate damage or healing.

checked_claims.claim: Mandatory effects, defender first, printed order, cancellation keeps combat number
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Mandatory unless otherwise specified; same-time defender first. Feint cancels effects, not printed combat value; multiphase/effect sentences applied in order.

checked_claims.claim: Combat win depends on attack damage only
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Attacker wins for at least 1 attack damage; defender wins with none, even if effect damage occurred.

checked_claims.claim: Feint versus Feint cancellation sequence
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Defender immediate Feint cancels attacker immediate Feint before it can resolve; both retain printed 2.

checked_claims.claim: Arthur Noble Sacrifice plus ability BOOST versus Feint
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Defender immediate cancellation cancels during-combat Noble effect, and printed Arthur cancellation clause discards initial ability BOOST without effect. Noble remains printed 2; textless Excalibur exception irrelevant.

checked_claims.claim: BIG Alice Momentous Shift versus Feint arithmetic
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Feint cancels conditional change to 5; original Shift 3 + separate BIG modifier 2 =5; Feint defense2; damage3.

checked_claims.claim: Zero health defeat, remove sidekick immediately, Harpy any damage
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Defeat for any zero-health cause, sidekick removed immediately; undialed sidekick 1 health.

checked_claims.claim: Immediate duel end precludes pending healing/effects
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Hero defeat immediately loses; game ends immediately. After-combat effects continue only if game not ended.

checked_claims.claim: Mandatory draws, exhaustion on each missing draw, no reshuffle
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Every mandatory card draw with empty deck substitutes 2 immediate damage to each own fighter; two missing draws are two events; one card remaining is drawn before missing-draw damage.

checked_claims.claim: Face-up separate discard piles, inspect at any time
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: All resolved/discarded cards use own face-up discard; both may inspect either.

checked_claims.claim: Health cap and no reviving after loss
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Health capped at fighter dial maximum; hero defeat ends game immediately.

checked_claims.claim: Place versus move; occupancy remains
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Cards expressly place in any permitted space; movement paths apply to move, not placement; p7 says space only one fighter.

checked_claims.claim: Voyage formula and three-discard example
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: During-combat printed2 +1 for each already-discarded other Voyage; played current card is not discarded until combat end. Three present yield 2+3=5.

checked_claims.claim: Voyage Home maneuver boost counts in both terms
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: BOOST discard occurs before movement; discarded Home has printed boost1 and is a Voyage in discard, so contributes +1 to both movement bonus and BOOST.

checked_claims.claim: Voyage Home retrieval and subsequent movement
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: AFTER COMBAT retrieves other Voyages already discarded; Home placed into discard finally. Home alone gives movement 2+1=3.

checked_claims.claim: Jaws/Skirmish timing, movement and mandatory damage example
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: 4 versus4 gives no attack damage; defender Arthur wins and resolves first; Skirmish moves Jabberwock away before its mandatory adjacent-fighter Jaws effect; absent adjacent target no damage.

checked_claims.claim: Missing BOOST is intentional and cannot pay BOOST
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: 2019-10-17 JustinDJacobson post33170907 author43936: no boost value specifically keeps Sinbad from dumping Voyages. Profile maps to designer4083 and Restoration publisher34846. Six originals lack BOOST; Home visibly has1.

checked_claims.claim: Current official Excalibur erratum, scope and timing
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: Official IELLO page dated11 August2025 says Restoration Games official change immediately applies to casual and tournaments; textless Excalibur effects cannot be canceled, preserving ability BOOST. Card remains printed6; standard final discard still follows p12.

checked_claims.claim: Historical Excalibur interpretation and supersession
checked_claims.evidence_or_reasoning: 2021-01-02 designer/publisher author43936 explicitly says Feint of boosted Excalibur cancels boost effect. Official2025 article describes former cancellation and replacement; candidate clearly labels past interpretation historical.

limitations: Bounded source-only audit as requested: no web, no questions/keys/scope maps, no prior audits, no reader outputs, no reports, and no unlisted repository files were read. Only assigned outputs and listed inputs were used.

Ancillary catalog/bibliographic fields such as BGG id274637, play-time20–40, source/retrieval dates, hosted rulebook links, and Steam module ownership/co-creation are not independently authenticated by these normative sources. They are not marked verified by this audit. PDF credits and copyright do support designers and ©2019 Restoration/©2020 IELLO attribution.

Original card PNG provenance is bounded by the supplied manifest and exact hashes; native card content was checked directly, but upstream Steam module publication history was not independently authenticated.

Raw captured HTML was fully read by the independent parser and hashed, not displayed as irrelevant full markup. Complete visible normative page and full containing article div were delivered; own parses equal supplied v2 captures after terminal-newline removal.

Optional team rules appear in the fully delivered source text, but are excluded from normative assessment. Other sets and Adventures are excluded. No requirement to summarize speculative expansion interactions was added.

No substantive unsupported, incorrect or materially missing in-scope rule/card/fighter claim was identified. A PASS applies to the exact stamped candidate, not to ancillary metadata authentication or a live current website beyond these captured official sources.
